proposed_rules.trigger: A tall content zone whose only captured text is a raw third-party embed initialization call (e.g. `hbspt.forms.create({...})`), indicating the widget's real markup (a form) did not render during headless capture.
proposed_rules.decision: Do not discard as plain noise (existing leaked-css-text-node targets stylesheet/script comment leaks, not unrendered widget calls). Treat the zone as a placeholder block (e.g. 'form' block referencing the embed) and flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM/network extraction to recover actual form fields.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) exclude entirely as noise like leaked-css-text-node — would silently drop a real contact form from the migrated page; (b) leave as default-content text — the raw JS is meaningless to authors. Flag-for-extraction preserves the content while acknowledging the capture limitation.
